title: Code and results for: Unicode-Aware, Position-Bound Integrity Verification of Digital Quran Text with a Signed Two-Level Merkle Registry
description: Code, result files and logs for a paper submitted to IMAN 2026 (Islamic Applications in Computer Science and Technologies). A position-bound, signed two-level Merkle registry for Quran text with Unicode-aware diagnosis of changes. Quran text copies are not included.

creators.name: Almamoori, Hiba Rashid
creators.affiliation: Department of Cyber Security, College of Information Technology, University of Babylon, Iraq
